Today's ACE batch has not arrived. |

Scenario: AC3 Right not held (exception X2)
    Given the role does not hold the Treatment and offer right of the operation
    When the route operation is called
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002, no read is made and no record is written

  Scenario: AC4 Case not at the route decision (exception X3)
    Given the case is not at the route decision, or the asset of the appraisal is not on the case
    When the appraisal step runs
    Then the step does not run, nothing is ordered and the state is reported to the parent

  Scenario: AC5 Order refused or run failed (exception X4)
    Given rwb-integration refuses the order or the interface run fails after the retry limit
    When the order is submitted
    Then the case stays at the route decision, the failure and its run reference are recorded, and the exception queue of rwb-integration holds the item

  Scenario: AC6 Stale ACE data product (exception X5)
    Given the ACE data product is stale after a late or failed batch
    When the age check runs
    Then the step holds, writes nothing and shows MSG-P1-001 with the data date, and resumes on a fresh answer

  Scenario: AC7 Appraisal not accepted (exception X6)
    Given the appraisal has no acceptance in valuation_ext
    When the route decision is taken
    Then no order is raised and the route decision names the missing acceptance with MSG-GEN-001

  Scenario: AC8 Appraisal inside the limit (exception X7)
    Given the appraisal is inside the limit
    When the age check runs
    Then nothing is ordered, the outcome is recorded with the limit version and the route decision continues

  Scenario: AC9 No answer inside 2 s (exception X8)
    Given rwb-source-data or rwb-case does not answer inside 2 s, or its breaker is open
    When the step calls the service
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule, nothing is written and the caller sees 503 with the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC10 Repeat with the same Idempotency-Key (exception X9)
